principle: Every ground-truth label follows mechanically from the construction's declared mechanisms via RULES below. Labels are fixed BEFORE outcomes exist. Implementation must match mechanisms exactly; mechanics-presence is independently tested pre-freeze (fail-closed otherwise). NEVER relabel to match observed behavior.

mechanism_primitives.truncate_bits_b:k: arm B effective seed = declared_seed & (2^k-1); declared stays full-width
mechanism_primitives.burn_draws_b:n: arm B consumes n extra dealer-stream draws before every paired unit
mechanism_primitives.event_keyed_policy_preserving: exogenous/chance events keyed by stable semantic ids; action policies preserved (random policy consumes keyed uniforms; conservative policy applies its deterministic rule); marginals uniform by SHA256-counter construction
mechanism_primitives.event_keyed_policy_blind: DELIBERATE replant of historical K003 defect: keyed path ignores policy for BOTH arms (heldem-only applicability)
mechanism_primitives.think_budget:scale: execution-stream draws are consumed under a wall-clock deadline each measured block (deadline scales with rank); the arm-to-arm COUPLED source (per-seed substream identity) stays intact while trajectories become context-sensitive — exactly how real time-bounded compute breaks replay without touching coupling
mechanism_primitives.module_cache_contam_b: simulated worker-reuse: persistent harness cache entry alters arm B's first unit deterministically
mechanism_primitives.queue_tax:{a_tax,b_tax}: deterministic per-arm dealer draw tax emulating enqueue-order dependence
mechanism_primitives.drop_rows_mod:m: every m-th scheduled row dropped after acquisition, before analysis
mechanism_primitives.duplicate_row_ids:f: fraction f of retained rows get duplicated row_ids (denominator corruption)
mechanism_primitives.persistent_state_cross_proc: harness persists small state file consumed deterministically by next executor; separates processes -> next-process digest differs (genuine cross-process divergence)
mechanism_primitives.stream_collision_b: arm B's keyed namespaces for 'dealer' and 'misc' logical streams collide (shared key prefix)
mechanism_primitives.ontology_drift_b: arm B logs event ids under renamed ontology (v2) while claim/declared ontology says v1; some stale keys accidentally intersect
mechanism_primitives.repeat_pairs_k:K: K paired repeats retained for BOTH arms with unique (system,construction,seed,arm,repeat_id,context) keys and honest residual variation
mechanism_primitives.repeat_ids_collide: declared repeats use colliding repeat_id values inside units (cluster keys unusable)
mechanism_primitives.analysis_unit:u: declared analysis unit: seed_condition | hand | decision
mechanism_primitives.design_declared:[...]: explicit declarations from {matched_paired_units, repeated_measures, hierarchical_model, defended_joint_model, independent_arms}
mechanism_primitives.independent_seeds_b:delta: B seed = A + delta, independence declared
mechanism_primitives.context_scope:s: scope asserted by any replay claim: within_artifact | cross_context_inproc | cross_process

truth_rules.R-A: descriptive=VALID iff rows_complete AND row_ids unique AND effective_seed==declared both arms AND denominators exact; else INVALID
truth_rules.R-C: replay=VALID only under the narrowest scope actually demonstrated: within_artifact requires projection-identical rerun; cross-context/cross_process claims additionally require identical digests across those distinct contexts/processes. Any mechanism changing execution state (think_budget|cache|queue|persistent_state|burn) falsifies contexts beyond within_artifact-at-best; never upgrade scope
truth_rules.R-B: paired_inference=VALID iff (a declared pairing basis exists among {matched_paired_units(+intact match), repeated_measures(with usable repeat clusters), defended_joint_model}) AND analysis_unit is cluster-respecting AND no mechanism destroys the DEFINITION of matched conditions beyond downgrade-class AND repeat clusters usable. DOWNclass list: truncate/burn/cache/queue/drop_rows/duplicates remove matched-realization or complete-denominator support -> DOWNGRADE (weaker statistical wording still sound). INVALID when: unit pseudoreplicated (decision/hand unit without clustering), repeat clusters unusable (collide), or arms independent while claim worded paired
truth_rules.R-D1: crn_coupling_validity=VALID iff synchronization construction demonstrably intact: stateful sync with zero cross-arm dealer desync OR event_keyed_policy_preserving with marginals preserved, streams separated, no collisions. INVALID when truncate|burn|cache|queue|collision|drift|policy_blind present
truth_rules.R-D2: variance benefit measured separately; NEVER part of D1 truth; degenerate zero-variance contrasts are flagged DEGENERATE_NOT_BENEFIT
truth_rules.R-E: event_alignment=N/A unless construction is event-keyed; VALID iff ontology identity/version match, matched-event coverage threshold met (>0 unmatched allowed only if declared partial ontology), key uniqueness holds, all compared values equal across arms
truth_rules.R-compound: compound constructions apply component rules jointly; the STRICTEST applicable outcome per dimension wins; derivation field records each contributing rule
